slots.name: years since rebrand
slots.sentence: Luxury carmaker Jaguar has launched its new all-electric vehicle, two years after the famed British company's controversial rebrand prompted a social media backlash.

slots.name: vehicle model
slots.sentence: The automotive manufacturer, which is owned by India's Tata Motors, unveiled the Type 01 model on Tuesday at an event in New York City, describing it as the "most technically advanced" and "most powerful and aerodynamic" Jaguar ever.

slots.name: UK starting price
slots.sentence: Jaguar's Type 01 has a starting price of £130,000 (roughly $172,000) in the U.K. and around $130,500 in the U.S., according to multiple media reports, which is significantly higher than previous comparable models.

slots.name: North America starting price
slots.sentence: Jaguar later confirmed to CNBC on Wednesday morning that the Type 01 model has a minimum price tag of $130,000 in North America.

slots.name: range
slots.sentence: The four-door "Grand Tourer" has an ultra-long bonnet, low roofline, frameless doors and a camera instead of a rear window. It has a range of up to 450 miles and can accelerate from 0-62 miles per hour in 3.2 seconds.
